title: WhatsappLinks
description: whatsapp-multiuser W1 (R-1..R-10, R-24, R-36). One link binds one KB user (userId) in one tenant to one archiver owner (archiverOwnerId), with a lifecycle: requested -> approved -> active <-> suspended; requested -> rejected; requested|approved|active|suspended -> unlinked|revoked (terminal). Health flags (needs-relink, stale, error, quiet) live in health.flags, never in state. userId is null only for a legacy link seeded once from WHATSAPP_TENANT_OWNER_MAP (R-24). live is derived from state (true for requested/approved/active/suspended, false for the terminal three) and exists so the unique partial index can enforce one non-terminal link per (tenantId, userId) (R-2). archiverOwnerId is unique across ALL tenants and states (R-2, never reused); it is redacted in logs and never returned to non-admins. studentData is the admin classification (R-4/R-32): per D-206 the default is no (WhatsApp-derived knowledge may reach external AI paths); the field stays so it can be tightened later. No message text, group subject, jid, phone number or QR data is ever stored here.

_id.description: Link id (24-hex, R-45). Also the archiver ownerRef (R-11).

userId.description: The users-collection id of the person who owns the link; null only for a legacy env-seeded link until an admin binds it (R-24).

live.description: Derived: true exactly for requested|approved|active|suspended. Keyed by the unique partial index.

archiverOwnerId.description: Archiver owner (users row there), stored by the KB after ensureOwner (R-11). Absent until provisioned.

noticeVersion.description: Hash of the notice text the person saw (R-3, R-49).

approvedBy.description: Admin user id; system:env-seed for a legacy seeded link.

approvalExpiresAt.description: Approved but never scanned links expire to unlinked/connect_timeout (R-5).

suspendedReason.description: Code, never free text (for example account_inactive).

unlinkedReason.description: Code, for example owner_request or connect_timeout.

archiverUnlinkPending.description: R-7/R-8 follow-through: set together with the move to unlinked|revoked while the archiver unlinkSession step is still owed; unset once the archiver confirmed (or answered owner_not_found/owner_unlinked). Only meaningful on a terminal link; the sync scheduler retries every tenant that still has one (W9). Never set when another link carries the same archiverOwnerId.

blocksNewRequests.description: R-8: a revoked link sets this; the person cannot request a new link until an admin clears it.

health.description: Last observed archiver/run health (R-34, R-35). Counts and codes only.
